excluded: optional variants including Delay of Game
scope.review_method: Independent comparison of all summary gameplay sections against the complete 32-page authoritative extracted rulebook, with direct visual inspection of embedded PDF artwork where text extraction omits values. Full core omission review performed independently of benchmark questions.
scope.independence: No question sets, keys, reader answers, grades, coverage files or other reports read; no reader communication; summary unmodified.

checked_claims.details: Individual clockwise turns without rounds; sixth star immediately ends play; greatest fortune wins, including when another player ended the game.

Five core factions and player mats; resources and named structures; character, four mechs, eight workers, four recruits, six technology cubes and six stars per faction; only character/mechs participate in combat.
Factory deck is players+1, unused cards returned unseen; one random face-up structure tile; 11 encounter locations; shuffled decks, supply, random mats and stated faction seating order.

checked_claims.details: Starting indicators and resources come from their indicated mats; character at home; two workers on land-adjoined territories; six workers and other pieces on correct mat spaces; recruit one-time spaces initially empty; lowest-numbered mat starts; two objective cards.

checked_claims.details: Combat-card hand count public but contents secret; objectives secret; coin total need not be calculated/revealed; cards committed in combat may be concealed until reveal.

Two different units, one step each, or one coin before upgrades; sequential movement; all units transport resources; only mechs transport workers; carriage does not consume a worker movement; river/lake distinction and default prohibition.

Printed tunnels are mutually adjacent for all units; Mine personal tunnel; structure-only entry takes control; independent worker restrictions; undefended workers retreat immediately leaving resources at one popularity each; plastic-unit entry stops and initiates later combat; encounters stop character.

One coin for two power or one combat card before upgrades; combat deck replenishment and exhausted-deck behavior; Monument adds one popularity.
One coin for two resources of any combination or one popularity before upgrades; resources placed on controlled worker territory; no resource Trade when all workers at home; Armory adds one power.

Mill is a bonus production territory and produces as a worker; actual workers also produce; no actual worker required; no production on enemy-controlled Mill territory.

Mat-specific full costs and coins; coins optional; completed actions remain available for coin/recruit benefits; oil Upgrade moves cube from green to empty bracketed red box, never solid-bordered red.
Pay metal; any covered mech goes to controlled worker territory, never lake; uncovered ability immediately applies to all character/mechs, excluding workers.

Pay wood; any structure goes to controlled worker territory; one structure total per territory; no lakes/home bases, Factory allowed; permanence; matching top action benefits, Mine universal movement access and owner-only abilities.
Pay food; recruit may come from any bottom section and occupy any open one-time faction bonus permanently; two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing bonus tied to removed recruit location.

checked_claims.details: Self and immediate neighbors trigger matching bottom action; top/Factory/encounter actions excluded; active then left then right; two-player opponent counted once; Upgrade power, Deploy coin, Build popularity, Enlist combat card, one each.

Relentless includes Factory; Coercion once per turn one card equals one resource independent of card value; Swim workers only, rivers but not lakes; Meander two different choices on one card in either order with gains usable for second cost; Dominate retains second objective and removes combat-star cap.
Saxony/Nordic forests and mountains; Rusviet farms and villages; Crimea farms and tundra; Polania villages and mountains; character/mechs only.
Underpass joins controlled mountains and tunnels including own Mine; Disarm causes opponent two track-power loss before tunnel/Mine combat once per combat.

Seaworthy permits lake movement and optional adjacent-lake retreats including carried workers; Artillery costs one track power to remove two opponent power, once per combat.
Wayfare from territory/home to own or any inactive home, including expansion placeholders regardless of distance; Scout steals random combat card once per combat.

Character backstories, designer notes, strategy tips, achievement-sheet commemoration and optional sample scoring exercise are omitted.
